        Quick facts

        Facts checked Nov. 3, 2026
        Motors and speed
        10 hp limit.
        Ramps and access
        MWCD lists two public launch ramps, an accessible kayak launch and an accessible fishing pier, plus South Fork and North Fork marinas.
        Normal pool
        Corps summer pool is 963 ft. No road circles the lake, so plan where you launch. Live level: USGS gauge 03120000.
        Night rules
        MWCD areas close from 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. except to people fishing, hunting or boating. Source: MWCD Rules and Regulations, rule 1.13.

        Sources: MWCD, Leesville Lake; ODNR, Leesville Lake Fishing Area; US Army Corps of Engineers, Leesville Lake; ODNR fishing map; MWCD Rules and Regulations, rule 1.13.

        How to read this
        • Pool is lake surface elevation in feet as USGS posts it, not the depth of any hole or channel.
        • The Corps summer pool is 963 ft. The ODNR fishing map (5 ft contours, surveyed 2000) labels its pool 997 ft on another datum, so no pool correction is worked out here.
        • No public water temp gauge on the lake, so the temp slot says n/a. Nothing is estimated.
        • Lake level comes from USGS gauge 03120000 near Bowerston. It is provisional and can be revised. USGS-03120000.
        • 10 hp limit (MWCD). No road circles the lake, so plan where you launch.

        Tonight’s bite

        A rule of thumb guide, not a promise.

        How the bite is rated

        The Bite is this site’s own rule of thumb, not fishing science and not a forecast. It adds points from readings already on this page.

        • Barometer, the change over the last 3 hours at the lake’s NWS station. Falling slowly +2, steady +1, rising slowly 0, falling fast 0, rising fast −1. Steady means within 0.02 inHg; fast means 0.06 inHg or more.
        • Wind, tonight’s average NWS hourly speed from sunset to 2 AM (the top of each hour’s range). Under 3 mph 0, 3 to 12 mph +1, 13 to 18 mph 0, over 18 mph −2.
        • Moon, worked out on this phone. New or full moon tonight (or under 10% or over 90% lit) +1, otherwise 0.
        • Water temp, from this lake’s USGS gauge where one reports it. 55 to 80°F +1, colder than 45 or warmer than 86°F −1, anything between 0. It never makes a rating alone.
        • Thunder anywhere in tonight’s NWS forecast makes it Tough, whatever the points.

        4 points or more is Good, 2 or 3 is Fair, less is Tough. A missing reading counts 0, and with no barometer trend and no wind there is no rating.

              Park hours and notes

              MWCD lake: 10 hp limit. MWCD lists two public launch ramps, a kayak launch and a fishing pier; the two marinas are pinned. No road circles the lake. Check posted MWCD hours before a night trip. Shoreline traced from OpenStreetMap, not for navigation.
